notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Hi!

Please find a couple of bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

Cheers,
Paper Beast Team

--- Patch Notes ---
SandBox:
- Fix Bridger behaviour that can be stuck in front of Voraxo.
- Allow entities to reproduce more that palette limit per entity.
- Bridgers, Papyvorus, Predators, insects can reproduce 2 or 3 entities at a time if population is high.

Chapter 3.4: Make sure player have enough "Bridger" in any situation

notes.title: HotFix 1.03
notes.content:
Hi!

This patch fixes a rare save issue for players who launched the Folded edition before patching to 1.02. It now makes sure to keep saved progression between VR and Folded edition.

Cheers,
Paper Beast Team

notes.title: Patch 1.02 - Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi!

Please find a couple of bug fixes and improvements. It includes tweak and gameplay adjustments.

Cheers,
Paper Beast Team

--- Patch Notes ---

 Fix simulation terrain issue on older graphic cards than GTX 970 like GTX 780

 Chapter 4.2: Improve creatures behaviour for a more fluent gameplay

 Chapter 6.3: Up to 3 LCD cubes
 Chapter 7: Adding extra underwater visual

notes.content:

notes.title: Launch date: July 24, 2020
notes.content:
We have great news!
Our VR adventure will release on Steam on July 24, 2020.

[previewyoutube=wHUROrXRWZE;full][/previewyoutube]
The PC version of the game will see a host of new features including:

- Continuous move support
- Upgraded visuals: (more precise textures and shadows, improved water and sand rendering, full support of latest gen VR headsets’ resolution)


In sandbox mode:
- Bigger sandbox area
- Expanded ecosystem, enriched by an evolution of the vegetation
- A greater number of entities in the field allowing more combinations
- A new species 
- Smoother gameplay


Eric Chahi says that “The PC version represents a more polished version of the game in almost all aspects but also offers continuous move support, which we are very proud of because we handled it without compromise. Special care was also given to the rendering of water and sand. You will be able to see the turmoil at the surface of the water, and the delicate flow of the sand. You’ll be able to dive even deeper into the fantastic world of Paper Beast”. 


We hope you are as excited as we are!

All the best,

Pixel Reef team.
